rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) – allowable rent increases
rules.requirement: For RSO units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months by the annual allowable percentage set by LAHD (3% for 7/1/2025–6/30/2026). Since Feb 2, 2026 no extra percentage for utilities and no extra 10% for an added dependent; 10% for an added non-dependent tenant is still allowed.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months; annual percentage set by LAHD (3% for 7/1/2025–6/30/2026)
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to
rules.effective_date_note: Date of the revised formula (no utility add-on, no dependent 10%) per LAHD; original ordinance start date not stated in documents. The 3% figure covers only through 2026-06-30; the current-year figure is not stated.
rules.exemptions: Condos/townhomes with tenancies commenced after 12/31/1995 not rent-regulated; luxury exemption; temporary exemptions.
rules.interaction: Local RSO governs instead of the state Tenant Protection Act cap for covered units.

unverifiable_exemptions: condominiums and townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commenced after Dec 31, 1995

rules.conflict_note: Two effective dates published for the new formula: 2026-02-02 (LAHD) and 2026-01-24 (landlord association). LAHD date used.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO – just cause eviction and LAHD notice filing
rules.requirement: RSO tenants can be evicted only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. Every eviction notice must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service; landlords must also post and provide the Notice of Right to Counsel. No eviction for unpaid rent unless the amount owed exceeds Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size (since 3/27/2023).
rules.key_value: Listed causes only; LAHD filing within 3 business days; no-fault requires relocation
rules.quoted_span: All eviction notices issued to tenants in the City of Los Angeles must be filed with LAHD within three (3) business days of service on the tenant
rules.effective_date_note: Underlying just-cause provisions' start date not stated; FMR non-payment limit effective 2023-03-27; Right to Counsel posting from 2025-08-20.

rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered units not under the RSO may not end a tenancy without just cause (at-fault reasons, or no-fault reasons such as owner move-in or demolition). No-fault evictions generally require relocation assistance. Rent owed must exceed Fair Market Rent before an eviction for non-payment (since 3/27/2023).
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.effective_date_note: Effective date not stated in documents; FMR non-payment limit effective 2023-03-27.
rules.coverage_conditions: Most residential properties not regulated by the RSO; applies once the tenant has lived in the unit six months or the original lease expired.
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless/treatment facilities, some HACLA or government-owned properties.
rules.interaction: Covers units outside the RSO; supersedes state Civ. Code § 1946.2 for covered units.

unverifiable_exemptions: some non-profit homeless facilities or treatment centers
tenant has not lived in unit six months or original lease not expired

rules.review_note: Section cite 165.03 inferred from relocation bulletin cross-references; complementary cutoff applied so JCO and RSO are not both reported for one building (older non-RSO units like single-family homes may also be JCO-covered).

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO/JCO no-fault eviction relocation assistance
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions from RSO or JCO units, landlords must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD before serving notice and pay relocation assistance, made available within 15 days of service. Amounts for 7/1/2026–6/30/2027 range from $11,000 to $27,400 per unit and rise each July 1.
rules.quoted_span: All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a
rules.effective_date_note: Current relocation amounts effective 2026-07-01; underlying ordinance start date not stated.
rules.exemptions: Resident manager replaced by another resident manager; natural-disaster hazardous conditions; reduced amounts for Mom and Pop properties and natural-person single-family dwellings.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO; tenant may raise non-payment as an affirmative defense.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family dwellings owned by natural persons (one month's rent)
Mom and Pop owner/family occupancy reduced payment

rules.title: Los Angeles Resident Protections Ordinance (RPO) – demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing Protected Units for new construction must pay enhanced relocation to lower-income households under one of three options, with standardized payments of $87,450–$115,480. Tenants may remain until 6 months before construction and have return and first-refusal rights.
rules.quoted_span: Owners have 3 relocation options to comply with the RPO relocation rules.
rules.effective_date_note: Bulletin states RPO effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances #188481 and #188482.
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.

unverifiable_exemptions: Protected Unit status (covenant, rent control, lower-income occupancy in past 5 years, Ellis withdrawal within 10 years)

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO security deposit interest
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units must pay tenants interest on security deposits, monthly or yearly, as a direct payment or rent credit, and tell the tenant in writing which method they chose. The City sets the rate annually (4.320% for 2025).
rules.key_value: Annual City-set interest rate (4.320% for 2025); paid monthly or yearly
rules.quoted_span: Security deposit interest must be paid to the tenant either monthly or annually.
rules.effective_date_note: Interest began accruing November 1, 1990 per quoted code text.
rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be used as a defense in eviction proceedings.

unverifiable_exemptions: Other RSO exemptions cannot be checked from parcel data

rules.review_note: Only a secondary source (D044) states the operative requirement; official D041 merely lists deposit interest among RSO topics.

no_rule_findings.finding: The 2024 council motion only asks LAHD to report on algorithmic rent-setting software and the feasibility of a ban. It is not a rule, so no local ban is shown.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based
